text:
maria: Heads-up — us-east1 GPU nodepools are reporting CASCADE_AUDIT quota_rejects, cluster-autoscaler is converging slowly. Pods with gpu request pending. Anyone else seeing cross-cluster spillover?

autoscaler-bot: [ALERT] scale_up_failed for pool=gpu-e1-rt - reason: quotaExceeded (GPUs). Timestamp 2024-11-02T09:12:03Z

devon: yep. got ~120 pending pods in namespace=serve-prod. CA wants to add nodes but cloud returns 429/Quota. We should avoid all-or-nothing fallback that stalls the whole queue.

sandeep: idea: introduce a "capacity-broker" queue — when primary fails, put pods into PendingQueue CR (annotation) and apply a lower-priority scheduling class + taint-tolerate to move them to standby pools in other regions.

kevin: +1. Also can we prioritize smaller-batch jobs to the cheaper T4 standby pool to keep latencies ok? Big A100 work stays queued until capacity.

ashley: cost concern: cross-region warm pools will incur reserved costs. we need a cost model. rough numbers: 4x T4 warm nodes ~= $0.9/hr vs 2x A100 reserved ~= $7/hr (ballpark). Need ROI for standby.

maria: agreed. runbook needs SLA tiers: gold -> block until A100 available, silver -> route to T4 standby with quantized model, bronze -> best-effort async via batch job.

devon: quick POC: use a mutating webhook to label pods with "capacity-class=standby" when primary reject occurs, then node-selector to standby nodepool. also use taint: node.kubernetes.io/standby=true:NoSchedule

maria: snippet for taint/label:
```
kubectl label pod $POD capacity-class=standby --overwrite
kubectl taint nodes -l pool=standby node.kubernetes.io/standby=true:NoSchedule
```

infra-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: infra/capacity-broker POC branch -> staging (build #782) :rocket:

sandeep: one more: use evict-batch threshold to drain lowest priority pods from primary when cross-region dispatch is enabled to free up ephemeral slots. config in ca-params: `evict_threshold_pct: 12`

kevin: watchouts: sticky session + KV cache invalidation if we switch regions. need short TTL on KV prefix or replicate across regions. Otherwise heavy cache-miss storm.

ashley: action items:
- dev: POC mutating webhook + capacity-queue (devon)
- ops: cost model calc + reserve analysis (ashley)
- infra: standby nodepool provisioning script + autoscaler hooks (sandeep)

maria: timeline? when can we test in staging?

devon: POC branch ready, running against a copy of serve-prod queue atm. can demo tomorrow 09:30 PT.

maria: sweet. add a brief note to runbook: "capacity-broker: when primary GPU quota blocked, tag pods, attempt standby route, cost opt-in per namespace" :thumbsup:

oncall: FYI — will need to update oncall runbook if we flip cross-region dispatch. Also check alert thresholds for cross-zone latency spikes.

maria: thanks all. let's meet 09:30 demo and decide thresholds.
